data.narrative: Completed Module 09 Automated Testing & Test Isolation. Built an automated integration test suite verifying redirect correctness, auth boundaries, IDOR cross-account isolation, URL security validation, retention purging, and async idempotency. Verified 100% test pass on isolated SQLite test database.
